color.note: Warm stone neutrals, one copper accent, PCB-mask green as the secondary. Light and dark themes share every name.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: App background behind every panel. Ink and ink-muted text sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Panels, sidebars, the G-code viewer, the top bar.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Inputs, cards and popovers raised above a panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: tracks of sliders, code gutters, segmented-control backing.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between panels and rows. Never the only cue that a control is a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, toggles and unchecked checkboxes; at least 3:1 on surface-200 and surface-300 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300 and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and units on every surface-* token; at least 5:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button, the active tab marker and the progress bar. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button and accent-coloured text or links on surface-100, surface-200 and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the current G-code line, active chips. Text on it is ink or accent-strong.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. Dark in the dark theme because the accent is lightened there.

tokens.name: mask
tokens.usage: PCB-mask green. Connected, done and success. Always paired with a word or check icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: mask-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success chips and the connected-machine card. Text on it is mask.

tokens.name: on-mask
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a mask fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surface-100, surface-200 and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners, for example a board that overhangs the peg grid.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, the emergency-stop button and destructive actions, always with a label or icon. Success and danger also differ in lightness, so they are not told apart by hue alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and the machine-fault chip. Text on it is danger.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring with a 2px surface gap. The one cool colour in the system, so focus is never confused with the copper accent. 3:1 or better on every surface-* token.

tokens.name: scene-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the 3D viewport.

tokens.name: scene-floor
tokens.usage: The peg-board floor plane in the 3D viewport.

tokens.name: scene-peg
tokens.usage: Peg holes and the alignment pegs; 3:1 or better on scene-floor.

tokens.name: scene-board
tokens.usage: The PCB body inside the cut outline. In the dark theme the board is also outlined with border-strong, because it is only 2.4:1 against the floor.

tokens.name: scene-blank
tokens.usage: The bare copper-clad blank the board is cut from, seen as a margin around scene-board with the peg holes in it; 3.3:1 (light) and 4.0:1 (dark) on scene-floor.

tokens.name: scene-copper
tokens.usage: Copper traces and pads from the Gerber, drawn on scene-board; 3:1 or better.

tokens.name: scene-laser
tokens.usage: The laser head, beam and the path about to be engraved.

tokens.name: scene-done
tokens.usage: Traces already engraved during simulation or a live job.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and the app name on the start screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Move the board to line it up with the pegs.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Offset is applied to every G-code move.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Live machine position and elapsed time.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; tight list rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding; gap inside a form row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, code highlights, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs and the viewport frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, toggles and slider thumbs.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Raised buttons and cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and dialogs.
